name: doc-editor
description: DocPad Studio - Root monorepo workspace for frontend and backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
